title: Getting started
summary: Host your first TAOM Coop server.

sections.heading: What you need
steps: Bannerlord 1.4.8, TAOM 2.0.29.5 and Bannerlord Coop from the Steam Workshop (3770450698), set up like a player.
TAOM.CoopCompat 0.3.25 needs Coop 0.1.6, and Steam now has Coop 0.1.7.
So hosting needs a Coop 0.1.6 dedicated server. Get it from Coop's GitHub release or the archived files on Nexus Mods.
Unpack it with 7-Zip, then click Choose Coop 0.1.6 server on the Saves page and pick that folder. Prepare server shows both links.
The TAOM.CoopCompat 0.3.25 HOST-OPERATOR zip is built into the server tool, so there is nothing to download for it.
While the Workshop has Coop 0.1.6, the tool finds its dedicated server by itself.
sections.tip: Use the TAOM client launcher first, so TAOM and Coop are installed the right way.

sections.heading: Bannerlord 1.5.7 (new)
steps: On Bannerlord 1.5.7 the tool hosts TAOM on the Coop v0.1.8 dedicated server. Coop 0.1.8 is not on the Steam Workshop.
Download BannerlordCoop-DedicatedServer-Win64-v0.1.8.7z. The link is in manifest.json on Coop's v0.1.8 GitHub release.
Unpack it with 7-Zip into a folder of its own.
Click Prepare server on the Saves page and pick that folder. It copies your own TAOM into the server. After a TAOM update, click Prepare server again.
Extra mods and a few server buttons don't work on a 1.5.7 server yet. The tool says so.

sections.heading: Make a campaign
steps: Open Bannerlord, start a new TAOM campaign in single player and save it. This tool does not make one.
Back in the tool, pick that save under Pick that save.
If it says Single player copy, click Name server copy. Your Documents save stays as it is.
Old TAOM 2.0.27 campaigns do not load on 2.0.29.5, so start a new 2.0.29.5 campaign.

sections.heading: Start the server
steps: Click Prepare server once. It builds the host folder. If the folder is already there, skip this.
Click Start server.
The first time, read the Coop server terms and click I accept.
Wait until the status says Server online. A gold bar shows the progress while it starts.
sections.tip: The first start of a new campaign builds the map cache and can take up to an hour. Do not stop the server while it does.

sections.heading: Next time
steps: The same campaign stays ready. Pick the Server copy and click Start server.
Stop server saves the world first, then closes the server.
Press What's new under the language button to see what changed in the last few versions.
